stem:
A child has bleeding gums. The teacher mentions a vitamin shortage.

What do vitamins and minerals mainly act as in food?

options.text: Energy-giving components, the same as sugar.
Protective food components; a shortage can show as a deficiency sign.
Muscle-building components, the same as proteins, with no protective role.

teacher.key_rationale: Vitamins and minerals are protective; deficiency evidence points to them, not to energy or muscle as their main class here.
